import subprocess, sys, json
def run(req):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/main.py'], input=json.dumps(req).encode(), capture_output=True)
    return p.stdout.decode().strip()

schema = [
    {'name': 't', 'type': 'TIME', 'min': -2147483648, 'max': 2147483647},
    {'name': 'sz', 'type': 'SIZE', 'min': -1024, 'max': 1024},
    {'name': 'c', 'type': 'COUNT', 'min': 0, 'max': 2147483647},
    {'name': 'g', 'type': 'ID', 'values': ['a']},
    {'name': 'fl', 'type': 'FLAG'},
]
K = 8
atoms = [
    # boundary offsets
    {'cmp': 'eq', 'left': {'field': 'g', 'at': 7}, 'right': {'const': 'a', 'type': 'ID'}},
    {'cmp': 'ge', 'left': {'aggregate': 'sum', 'field': 'sz', 'from': 7, 'to': 7},
     'right': {'const': -1024, 'type': 'SIZE'}},
    {'cmp': 'le', 'left': {'aggregate': 'mean', 'field': 'c', 'from': 0, 'to': 7},
     'right': {'const': 2147483647, 'type': 'COUNT'}},
    {'cmp': 'eq', 'left': {'scale': 1024, 'term': {'field': 'sz', 'at': 0}},
     'right': {'scale': -1024, 'term': {'const': -1, 'type': 'SIZE'}}},
    {'cmp': 'ge', 'left': {'add': [{'field': 't', 'at': 7}, {'const': 2147483647, 'type': 'TIME'}]},
     'right': {'const': -2147483648, 'type': 'TIME'}},
    {'quantifier': 'all', 'from': 0, 'to': 7,
     'predicate': {'cmp': 'ne', 'left': {'field': 'fl', 'at': '$'},
                   'right': {'const': False, 'type': 'FLAG'}}},
    {'quantifier': 'any', 'from': 7, 'to': 7,
     'predicate': {'cmp': 'gt', 'left': {'add': [{'field': 'c', 'at': '$'}, {'field': 'c', 'at': 0}]},
                   'right': {'const': 0, 'type': 'COUNT'}}},
    # deep but legal: depth 4, 15 nodes on one side
    {'cmp': 'ge',
     'left': {'add': [{'add': [{'add': [{'field': 'c', 'at': 0}, {'field': 'c', 'at': 1}]},
                               {'add': [{'field': 'c', 'at': 2}, {'field': 'c', 'at': 3}]}]},
                       {'add': [{'add': [{'field': 'c', 'at': 4}, {'field': 'c', 'at': 5}]},
                                {'add': [{'field': 'c', 'at': 6}, {'field': 'c', 'at': 7}]}]}]},
     'right': {'const': -1, 'type': 'COUNT'}},
]
req = {'version': 1, 'schema': schema, 'window': K, 'atoms': atoms,
       'policy': {'max_width': 4, 'min_support': 1, 'min_witness': 1},
       'train': [{'id': 'T0', 'source': 's0', 'rows': [
           {'t': i, 'values': [2147483647, 1024, 2147483647, 'a', True]} for i in range(K)]},
                 {'id': 'T1', 'source': 's0', 'rows': [
           {'t': i, 'values': [-2147483648, -1024, 0, 'a', False]} for i in range(K)]}],
       'probes': [{'id': 'P0', 'source': 's0', 'rows': [
           {'t': i, 'values': [0, 0, 0, 'a', False]} for i in range(K)]}],
       'queries': [{'id': 'Q0', 'source': 's0', 'rows': [
           {'t': i, 'values': [5, 1, 3, 'a', True]} for i in range(K)]}]}
out = run(req)
print('boundary acceptance ->', out[:200])
assert '"error"' not in out, 'boundary values must be accepted'
r = json.loads(out)
print('classes', len(r['classes']), 'queries', len(r['queries']))
print('OK: all inclusive boundaries accepted')
